iconicAnchor.label: CERN's first website and line-mode browser
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Tim Berners-Lee, Nicola Pellow, CERN, and early web publishing
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: CERN's restored web history establishes the direct document structure, text links, public information purpose, and browser-native behavior that ground the style.

sources.title: The birth of the Web
supports: The first website was an information page about the web itself, built for direct knowledge sharing.
Early web presentation centered documents, links, and browser behavior instead of decorative simulation.

sources.title: Why bring back the line-mode browser?
supports: The line-mode browser demonstrates an image-free, character-based interface organized around explicit navigation.
CERN's preservation effort ties the style to foundational web values rather than a nostalgic visual costume.
